name: Ventoy multi-boot USB
description: Official multi-boot USB solution for supported ISO/WIM/IMG/VHD(x)/EFI images. Install Ventoy once on a selected USB, then copy supported image files to its data partition; compatibility varies by image and firmware.
license_note: Ventoy is open source under its published licence. Each bootable OS image remains subject to its own licence and verification rules.

tutorials.title: Ventoy official getting-started guide
tutorials.scope: Official instructions for installing Ventoy to USB, copying image files and booting from the menu.
notes: Initial Ventoy installation formats the selected USB and deletes its data.
Use Update rather than Install when updating an existing Ventoy drive, and verify the target before confirming.
The initial Install operation formats the selected USB; it is not safe for a drive containing files you need.
After Ventoy is installed, copying additional ISO files normally does not require reformatting the data partition.
Check the official tested-image list and release notes; some OS images need special handling.
Never select the existing E2B USB unless you explicitly intend to replace its layout; Shopnoltd recovery instructions must preserve it by default.
